title_zh: 京张智环 AI 场景卡与折返治理清单
title_en: Jing-Zhang AI Civic Loop Scenario Cards and Switchback Governance

governance_protocol.name: scenario-switchback-lite
governance_protocol.license_note: Issue #1119 describes the reusable protocol text as CC-BY-4.0; this package records an adapted, proposal-local scenario governance profile.
governance_protocol.default_public_equivalent_path: A non-AI or staff-assisted alternative must remain available within the same public-service workflow.
governance_protocol.red_state_rule: A scenario returns to the previous stable operating state when safety, privacy, authorization, accessibility, or public-complaint triggers cross the agreed threshold.
governance_protocol.non_claim: All thresholds are conceptual design targets, not government commitments, procurement terms, or approved operating rules.

spatial_anchor.note: AI Origin Community is provisional and must be re-anchored when official polygons are published.

cards.ai_capability: Release-note translation, dependency-risk explanation, public demo scheduling, and contribution index navigation.
cards.data_boundary: Only project-supplied release metadata and voluntarily submitted public repository links may be processed.
cards.human_review: Community operator reviews event eligibility, rights status, and public wording before display.
cards.switchback_trigger: Unauthorized code, unclear license, unreviewed personal data, or disputed public claim.

spatial_anchor.note: Use controlled demonstration areas before any real-block trial.

cards.ai_capability: Test constrained urban-service agents against synthetic tasks, safety prompts, fallback paths, and audit logs.
cards.data_boundary: Synthetic or fully public task data only; no resident trajectory, face, device identifier, or enterprise confidential data.
cards.human_review: A named operator approves each test window, monitors logs, and can stop the trial immediately.
cards.switchback_trigger: Unsafe autonomous action, missing audit log, failed human takeover, or any attempt to use non-public data.

spatial_anchor.note: Road links are conceptual centerlines rather than road redlines.

cards.ai_capability: Convert public reports and field-check tasks into a ranked list of pedestrian, cycling, lighting, and wayfinding gaps.
cards.data_boundary: Use anonymous public feedback and field notes; do not infer personal movement patterns.
cards.human_review: Transport and public-space reviewers confirm every issue before it becomes a project suggestion.
cards.switchback_trigger: False location claim, privacy complaint, accessibility harm, or unresolved public dispute.

spatial_anchor.note: Service placement follows conceptual land-use zones.

cards.ai_capability: Explain nearby public services, talent services, event access, and non-AI contact channels.
cards.data_boundary: Preference storage must be optional and local to the service session unless explicit consent is recorded.
cards.human_review: Human service staff handle housing, legal, medical, financial, or qualification conclusions.
cards.switchback_trigger: Unapproved personal profiling, discriminatory suggestion, or missing human handoff.

cards.ai_capability: Display model-evaluation, safety-case, red-team, and incident-response workflows in a public-readable sequence.
cards.data_boundary: Use public demonstration cases and sanitized aggregate evidence only.
cards.human_review: Safety reviewer approves case wording and removes unverified performance claims.
cards.switchback_trigger: Unverified benchmark claim, unsafe prompt example, missing incident owner, or license dispute.

spatial_anchor.note: Near-campus interface is conceptual pending campus, ownership, and planning controls.

cards.ai_capability: Match public research outputs, mentor office hours, IP-service appointments, and demo-day requests.
cards.data_boundary: No confidential research, patent draft, student record, or enterprise NDA material may be ingested.
cards.human_review: Technology-transfer staff confirm eligibility and route legal/IP questions to professionals.
cards.switchback_trigger: Confidential material submitted, IP ownership unclear, or professional advice boundary exceeded.

spatial_anchor.note: Dazhongsi anchor is affected by Issue #1029 and must stay conceptual.

cards.ai_capability: Explain how public datasets, consent, anonymization, licensing, and deletion rights shape city services.
cards.data_boundary: Demonstrations use mock or already-public datasets; no live personal data is displayed.
cards.human_review: Data-governance reviewer approves examples and removes any dataset with unclear rights.
cards.switchback_trigger: Unclear data rights, re-identification risk, or public misunderstanding that cannot be corrected on site.

spatial_anchor.note: Facility capacity is pending municipal and energy engineering data.

cards.ai_capability: Expose small-scale edge-compute demos, energy-use dashboards, and carbon-aware task scheduling as public education.
cards.data_boundary: Only aggregate energy and task-class statistics may be displayed.
cards.human_review: Municipal and energy professionals must confirm capacity before any equipment installation.
cards.switchback_trigger: Energy-load uncertainty, thermal or fire-safety issue, unavailable operator, or misleading carbon claim.

spatial_anchor.note: Route follows the provisional heritage-park and blue-green system.

cards.ai_capability: Provide bilingual heritage interpretation, accessibility-oriented route explanation, and provenance links.
cards.data_boundary: Use public heritage text and cleared package material; do not generate unsupported historical claims.
cards.human_review: Heritage and copyright reviewer checks every story card and image before publication.
cards.switchback_trigger: Unverified historical statement, rights dispute, accessibility route failure, or public correction not addressed.

cards.title_zh: 全球 AI 活动周路线

spatial_anchor.note: Event route is a conceptual operation layer, not a confirmed public event.

cards.ai_capability: Arrange multilingual route explanation, agenda navigation, public Q&A summaries, and post-event knowledge capture.
cards.data_boundary: Only public agenda and opt-in participant questions may be used.
cards.human_review: Event operator, rights reviewer, and public-safety reviewer approve any public release.
cards.switchback_trigger: Unapproved event claim, crowd-safety concern, rights issue, or missing non-digital service path.

personas.public_interest_check: Needs visible contribution credit, license clarity, and non-exclusive access.
Needs affordable service access and clear separation between testing and public deployment.
Needs professional reception without crowding out public-service space.
Needs low-disruption mobility, opt-out paths, and no personal profiling.
Needs campus-city access, IP boundaries, and ordinary daily services.
